gaps.verbatim: spaced program, pwsh: the renderer quotes the program word; pwsh reads a quoted word as a string — invoking it needs the call operator & (owner decision: per-shell rows or a documented entry)
gaps.verbatim: spaced program, cmd: the renderer quotes the program word; cmd reads a single-quoted word literally — invoking it needs double quotes (owner decision: per-shell rows or a documented entry)
